input-2461.label: Dominant cycle period
input-2461.description: Period (trading days) of the largest FFT peak in the detrended close-price window, tanh-normalised. -1 when no cycle is resolvable.

input-2462.label: Spectral concentration
input-2462.description: Power in the dominant spectral peak / total spectral power, mapped to [-1, 1]. High = one clean price rhythm; low = noise. -1 when undefined.

input-2463.label: Dominant cycle phase (sin)
input-2463.description: Sine of the dominant-cycle phase at asOf — where the stock sits in its own cycle (trough vs peak). 0 when no cycle is resolvable.

input-2464.label: Dominant cycle phase (cos)
input-2464.description: Cosine of the dominant-cycle phase at asOf — where the stock sits in its own cycle (trough vs peak). 0 when no cycle is resolvable.

input-2465.label: Second cycle power ratio
input-2465.description: Power in the 2nd-strongest distinct spectral peak / total power, mapped to [-1, 1]. Lets NEAT weigh multi-cycle stocks. -1 when undefined.

input-2466.label: Third cycle power ratio
input-2466.description: Power in the 3rd-strongest distinct spectral peak / total power, mapped to [-1, 1]. Lets NEAT weigh multi-cycle stocks. -1 when undefined.

input-2467.label: Body-to-range ratio (latest)
input-2467.description: (close − open) / (high − low) for the latest bar. Sign = bullish/bearish, magnitude = conviction. Naturally in [-1, 1].

input-2468.label: Body-to-range ratio (mean)
input-2468.description: Short rolling mean of the body-to-range ratio over the last few bars; smooths single-bar noise. In [-1, 1].

input-2469.label: Upper wick share (latest)
input-2469.description: (high − max(open,close)) / (high − low), centred to [-1, 1]. Long upper wick = rejection from above.

input-2470.label: Lower wick share (latest)
input-2470.description: (min(open,close) − low) / (high − low), centred to [-1, 1]. Long lower wick = rejection from below.

input-2471.label: Engulfing pattern
input-2471.description: Bullish (+) / bearish (−) engulfing membership, graded by the engulfing body vs recent average true range. 0 when absent.

input-2472.label: Harami pattern
input-2472.description: Bullish (+) / bearish (−) harami: a small body contained within the prior larger body; graded by containment. 0 when absent.

input-2473.label: Hammer / hanging-man pattern
input-2473.description: Long-lower-wick small-body reversal, signed by the prior short-term trend (hammer after a fall = +, hanging-man after a rise = −). 0 when absent.

input-2474.label: Shooting-star / inverted-hammer pattern
input-2474.description: Long-upper-wick small-body reversal, signed by the prior short-term trend (shooting star after a rise = −, inverted hammer after a fall = +). 0 when absent.

input-2475.label: Doji pattern
input-2475.description: Tiny-body indecision bar; dragonfly (long lower wick) = +, gravestone (long upper wick) = −, symmetric ≈ 0. 0 when body is not doji-sized.

input-2476.label: Marubozu pattern
input-2476.description: Near-wickless full-body bar, signed by body direction (bullish +, bearish −), magnitude = body share. 0 when wicks are present.

input-2477.label: Morning / evening star pattern
input-2477.description: Three-bar reversal: morning star (+) / evening star (−), graded by the confirming third body vs average true range. 0 when absent.

input-2478.label: Piercing / dark-cloud-cover pattern
input-2478.description: Two-bar reversal: piercing (+) / dark-cloud-cover (−), graded by how far the current bar penetrates the prior body. 0 when absent.

input-2479.label: Pattern-context confirmation
input-2479.description: Strongest context-free pattern score × (−prevailing short-trend sign): confirms a reversal appears after a move. In [-1, 1].

input-2481.label: news-volume-momentum-3

input-2482.label: news-volume-momentum-7

input-2483.label: news-relevance-momentum-3
input-2483.description: 3-day mean relevance-share intensity vs the ticker's own 90-day average; weights each article by how relevant the ticker is to it. In [-1, 1].

input-2484.label: news-relevance-momentum-7
input-2484.description: 7-day mean relevance-share intensity vs the ticker's own 90-day average relevance share. In [-1, 1].

input-2485.label: news-attention-concentration-28
input-2485.description: Mean relevance share per article over 28 days: how central the ticker is to the articles that mention it (within-data substitute for a cross-sectional rank). Centred to [-1, 1].

input-2486.label: news-coverage-focus-28
input-2486.description: Mean count share per article over 28 days: high == coverage is mostly about this ticker, low == always name-dropped among many others. Centred to [-1, 1].

input-2487.label: news-coverage-breadth-momentum-7
input-2487.description: Distinct topics mentioned alongside the ticker in the last 7 days vs its own 90-day typical breadth. In [-1, 1].

input-2490.label: Time since peak (30d)

input-2504.label: Log-EPS growth slope (30q)
input-2504.description: tanh(8 × slope) of an OLS fit to ln(EPS) over the trailing ~30 quarters (only quarters with EPS > 0 and dated ≤ asOf). A smoothed long-run per-quarter compounding rate; positive = compounding up. In [-1, 1].

input-2505.label: Log-EPS fit quality R² (30q)
input-2505.description: 2·R² − 1 of the ~30-quarter log-EPS OLS fit: how steadily exponential the earnings path is. +1 = a clean straight-line compounder, −1 = an erratic/unresolvable fit. In [-1, 1].

input-2506.label: Log-EPS growth slope (12q)
input-2506.description: tanh(8 × slope) of an OLS fit to ln(EPS) over the trailing ~12 quarters; read against the 30q slope it signals growth acceleration vs deceleration. In [-1, 1].

input-2507.label: P/E stretch vs own history
input-2507.description: tanh(z) of the current TTM P/E against the stock's own trailing ~40-quarter P/E distribution (point-in-time, dated ≤ asOf). +1 = richest end of its own historical range, −1 = cheapest. Era-independent mean-reversion signal. In [-1, 1].

input-2508.label: Earnings-yield stretch vs own history
input-2508.description: tanh(z) of the current earnings yield (TTM EPS ÷ price) against its own trailing distribution. Defined even when TTM EPS ≤ 0 (where P/E is not); as the inverse of P/E a positive value signals CHEAP relative to the stock's history. In [-1, 1].

input-2509.label: EV/EBITDA stretch vs own history
input-2509.description: tanh(z) of the current EV/EBITDA (capital-structure-neutral) against its own trailing distribution. +1 = richest end of its own historical range. In [-1, 1].

input-2510.label: P/E valuation percentile
input-2510.description: 2·p − 1 where p is the current P/E's percentile rank within its own trailing distribution: a non-parametric richness gauge robust to the fat-tailed P/E distribution. +1 = top of its own range. In [-1, 1].
